precedence: This release scope replaces the 2026-09-09 V1 composition: an agent-first permissionless chat (phase A: headless daemon, CLI, skill, groups, coins, identity server, royalty; phase B: GUI) on macOS and Linux. Storage and payment follow V1_STORAGE_REDESIGN_2026_09_24.md. The source packet remains historical.

v1_task_scope_overrides.M06: Skill and headless CLI for everything: identity, daemon, contacts, messages, groups, coins, grants; skill installation via a CLI command.
v1_task_scope_overrides.U04: Phase B: panel of agents, grants and revocation.
v1_task_scope_overrides.X05: V1: end-to-end agent messaging via the packaged CLI skill and MCP, restart/poll/ack, NAT/relay, malicious content and revoke. OCR/coding/inference orders and reviews — V2.
v1_task_scope_overrides.X06: V1: release by the 67 active cards in their current scope and the 22 mandatory E2E; V2 cards and scenarios are not release dependencies.
v1_task_scope_overrides.I04: Contact by ID without an invitation: introductions mailbox H(intro,pubkey), published KeyPackages, paid contact request, recipient policy; off-network invitations are an additional path.
v1_task_scope_overrides.I05: MLS for direct chats on a single device; multiple devices — V2.
v1_task_scope_overrides.D03: 10 holders in the recipient mailbox swarm, "saved" at 7 receipts.
v1_task_scope_overrides.D04: Repair within the swarm: re-sending, reconciliation and handover on membership change; storage checks.
v1_task_scope_overrides.D05: Reading the mailbox by cursor from several swarm members; gaps by MLS sequence numbers; signed conversation head.
v1_task_scope_overrides.G02: Commit ordering via the notary by H(group_id, epoch), without BFT.
v1_task_scope_overrides.G03: Competing commits: the loser is rebuilt on the new epoch.
v1_task_scope_overrides.G04: Long offline: re-adding by an admin.
v1_task_scope_overrides.L01: Buying coins on a public L2 testnet; the contract immutably splits the payment: network share and operator pool.
v1_task_scope_overrides.L02: Operator registry with stake for the swarm, the notary and slashing on violation proofs.
v1_task_scope_overrides.L03: Identity-server issuance: grant books (domain, server, book, day, serial, N, expiry); daily limit in the GrantIssuer contract, changed by the owner no more than once per day and by no more than 10x, checked by holders; grant registration with the notary on the same day; instead of an on-chain SubsidyVault.
v1_task_scope_overrides.L04: Royalty: an immutable network share of every purchase with no control rights.
v1_task_scope_overrides.L06: Book payment verification via RPC on the node's choice after N confirmations; no quorum of attestors.
v1_task_scope_overrides.P03: Postage stamp notary and double-spend proofs instead of a BFT committee.
v1_task_scope_overrides.P05: A fixed price per message class.
v1_task_scope_overrides.P06: Regression of attacks on postage stamps: double spend, forged books and grant books above the limit.
v1_task_scope_overrides.O01: Google OAuth on our identity server (web), not in the client.
v1_task_scope_overrides.O04: Deduplication of issuance by Google account on the server and a network-wide daily issuance limit.
v1_task_scope_overrides.O06: Free start — a grant book from the identity server.
v1_task_scope_overrides.M01: A thin stdio MCP over the same operations, without jobs.*.
v1_task_scope_overrides.M02: Inbox/outbox, ack and inbox watch for agents.
v1_task_scope_overrides.U06: Headless CLI builds for macOS and Linux; updates — V2.
v1_task_scope_overrides.U02: Phase B: onboarding with own keys and Google via the identity server.
v1_task_scope_overrides.U03: Phase B: group UX; devices and privacy profiles — V2.
v1_task_scope_overrides.X03: Economic security: double spend, issuance limit, royalty.

requirement_scope_overrides.R17: V1: CLI skill/MCP, identity/send/delivery/poll/ack, grants, restart and NAT. Service discovery and job lifecycle — V2.
requirement_scope_overrides.R21: V1: account-trust and scoped identity credentials. ExecutorDeclaration, client evaluation and rating — V2.
requirement_scope_overrides.R23: V1: shared permission constraints, data scope, budgets and fail-closed. Order subcontracting contracts and engine — V2.
requirement_scope_overrides.R24: V1: groups and limited members without a shared root key. Specialized job rooms and work execution organization — V2.
requirement_scope_overrides.R34: V1: ordinary encrypted attachments, chunks/manifest, resumable transfer and repair. Job ArtifactManifest/results — V2.
requirement_scope_overrides.R35: V1: Tauri for contacts, chats, groups, devices, search, notifications, backup, settings and agent grants. Orders/reviews/rating — V2.
requirement_scope_overrides.R42: V1: real CLI/MCP messaging scenarios, restart, NAT and permission denials. Applied OCR/coding/inference orders — V2.
requirement_scope_overrides.R52: User decision of 2026-09-09: agent orders, performer discovery, reviews and rating moved to V2; the absence of these features does not block V1.

network works without company resources except coin grants
